# CleverStack: Full-Stack Web, App & Software Development

> CleverStack is a remote team of full-stack developers and software engineers building websites, online stores, web apps, SaaS products, mobile apps, desktop apps and plugins for businesses worldwide, mainly in the USA, UK, Canada, Germany and the rest of Europe. Fixed quotes before work starts; the client owns the code.

## Packages (USD, fixed price)
- Starter Website ($499): up to 5 pages, mobile-responsive, SEO foundation, 5–7 days
- Business Website ($999): up to 10 pages with CMS, custom theme, advanced SEO
- E-Commerce Store ($1,749): Shopify or WooCommerce store, up to 20 products
- Custom Web App ($3,000): logins and roles, database, one API integration, admin panel, 14–28 days
- SEO & Growth ($549): technical SEO audit, keyword research, on-page optimisation
- Fix & Redesign ($799): site audit, redesign, speed optimisation
- Mobile apps from $3,000 (iOS + Android), desktop apps from $5,000, plugins and browser extensions from $1,000
- Prices in pounds and euros: https://cleverstack.dev/web-development-uk, https://cleverstack.dev/web-development-europe

## Common questions
### How much does a Shopify store cost?
Our E-Commerce Store package starts at $1,749 and covers up to 20 products, cart and checkout, payments, shipping and tax, search and filtering, and order management. Larger catalogues, custom features or a migration from another platform are quoted after a free call. You get a fixed quote before any work starts.
### How long does it take to build a Shopify store?
Most stores are delivered in 10 to 18 days once we have your products, images and branding. A migration or a fully custom theme can take longer, and you will get a specific timeline in your proposal.
### How much does an MVP cost?
Our Custom Web App package starts at $3,000. Most SaaS MVPs with billing and onboarding cost more, depending on the core workflow. After a free call we give you a fixed quote for an agreed scope, so the price does not creep.
### How long does it take to build an MVP?
Most MVPs take 4 to 10 weeks from agreed scope to launch. A tighter scope launches sooner.
### How much does a mobile app cost?
Mobile apps start from $3,000 for iOS and Android. The final price depends on the features, so we scope it on a free call and give you a fixed quote with milestones before any work starts.
### Do you build for both iPhone and Android?
Yes. We use React Native, so one codebase runs on both, which is faster and cheaper than two separate apps.
### How much does it cost to hire full-stack developers?
Fixed-price projects start at $499 for a website and $3,000 for a custom web app. Ongoing development is quoted as a monthly plan after a free call, based on how much work you have each month.
### Can I hire a full-stack developer for an existing codebase?
Yes. We start with a short review of the code, infrastructure and open issues, then fix, extend or gradually improve it.
